# commercetools_integration_layer_allowlist (Resource)

The hosts the Commerce Integration Layer extension may call with `fetch`. A host is reachable when it matches an `allow` pattern and no `deny` pattern. A request to any other host fails at request time, not when the bundle is pushed.

A Project has one allowlist, so define this resource once per Project. It replaces the whole list, including hosts added with the commercetools CLI. Destroying it empties the list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "commercetools_integration_layer_allowlist" "allowlist" {
  allow = [
    "cdn.contentful.com",
    "preview.contentful.com",
    "*.algolia.net",
    "*.algolianet.com",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allow` (Set of String) Host patterns: a host such as `cdn.contentful.com`, or a leading wildcard such as `*.algolia.net`. No scheme, port or path. The API stores them in lowercase, so they have to be written that way.

### Read-Only

- `deny` (Set of String) Host patterns commercetools does not allow, whatever `allow` says.
- `id` (String) The key of the Project the allowlist belongs to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The allowlist is a singleton per Project, so it is imported using the
# Project key.
terraform import commercetools_integration_layer_allowlist.allowlist my-project-key
```
